study_identification_part.si_4_title: Sex Determines Anterior Cingulate Cortex Cortical Thickness in the Course of Depression

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: REST-MetaMDD Consortium dataset from 25 research groups across 17 hospitals in China.
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: "Structural brain imaging data were used from the REST-MetaMDD Consortium (35), which consists of 25 research groups in 17 hospitals in China."

answer.REST-meta-MDD: Primary dataset for MDD vs HC comparisons and normative modeling of ACC cortical thickness.

dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.detail: Used to contrast MDD patients with healthy controls and to derive normative model-based z scores for ACC CT.
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.supporting_text: "Taken from the large open-source REST-meta-MDD database, we contrasted 499 patients with MDD ... and 524 healthy control participants using linear mixed-effects models and normative modeling"; "we also applied neuroanatomical normative modeling to capture individual-level variability in ACC CT"
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.location: Wu2024.pdf.md: ABSTRACT; Wu2024.pdf.md: METHODS AND MATERIALS / Data Analysis
